soft-whoosh.wav.description: An airy, smooth whoosh: filtered air that sweeps up and back down, peaking in the middle.

quick-swish.wav.description: A fast, bright swipe that rushes upward and is gone, good for a title leaving the frame.

title-swell.wav.description: A gentle airy swell that builds and settles into a soft two-note bloom at the end; the peak is near the end of the file.

ball-bounce.wav.description: A rubber ball hitting a floor: a quick pitched thump with a small noise transient and a fast decay.

soft-impact.wav.description: A deep, soft cinematic thud with a short low tail, for something landing.

pop.wav.description: A round, bubbly pop: a short pitched blip that drops quickly, for something appearing.

pop-high.wav.description: A higher, lighter version of the bubbly pop, for small things appearing.

click.wav.description: A crisp, dry UI click like a mouse or trackpad press.

latch.wav.description: A toggle latch: two tiny clicks close together, the second slightly heavier.

key-tap.wav.description: A single soft keyboard key press.

typing.wav.description: A quick run of about fourteen soft key taps with uneven timing, like fast typing.

success-chime.wav.description: Two soft bell-like notes a fifth apart, friendly and short, for a confirmation such as copied.

paper-slide.wav.description: Soft filtered noise that rises and falls, like a card sliding across a desk.

shutter.wav.description: A light camera shutter: two quick mechanical clicks with a short noise burst between them.
